lessonRef.title: Guided practice B: rearranging formulas to highlight a chosen variable

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Read once, then cover the example and try the guided set from memory.

items.prompt: A $40 fee plus $15 per hour totals $115. Write the equation.

steps: Fee is constant; hourly rate multiplies h.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: The formula A = -3bh − 4 models a design constraint, where A, b, and h are positive. Solve it for h.
Item A costs $11 each and item B costs $8 each. You may spend at most $320 in total. Which inequality expresses this constraint on the counts a and b?
A tank holds 90 litres and is filling at 2 litres per minute. After how many minutes does it hold 114 litres?
A model gives a required side length of −6 metres. How should this solution be interpreted?
choices: Use 6 metres, taking the absolute value.
Report −6 metres, because the algebra is correct.
Reject the solution; a length cannot be negative, so it lies outside the model’s domain.
Add 6 to every measurement to correct the model.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A repair service charges a $15 call-out fee plus $5 per hour. A job cost $90 in total. Which equation determines the number of hours h?
The formula A = -5bh + 6 models a design constraint, where A, b, and h are positive. Solve it for h.
Item A costs $23 each and item B costs $12 each. You may spend at most $280 in total. Which inequality expresses this constraint on the counts a and b?
A tank holds 255 litres and is filling at 11 litres per minute. After how many minutes does it hold 409 litres?

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: A model gives the number of buses needed as 4.3. How should this solution be interpreted?
choices: Round up to 5; a fractional bus is not viable and rounding down leaves people behind.
The model must be wrong, because the answer is not a whole number.
Round down to 4, because 4.3 is closer to 4.
Report 4.3, because the model is exact.
